name: @apps-in-toss/launcher-site
description: Real-device attach launcher PWA, deployed to GitHub Pages at /launcher/ (LAUNCHER_URL target — packages/debugger/src/mcp/deeplink.ts; the devtools-side copy of this constant was removed along with packages/devtools, C4). Lives outside pnpm workspace (not a packages/* member, never published) — moved out of packages/devtools/e2e/fixture originally so removing that package (D1b/C4) wouldn't drag launcher hosting down with it (docs/release-plan.md Phase 1 B4), and packages/devtools has since been removed (C4). This manifest is documentation only, not an install/resolution target: there is no node_modules here — deps (react, react-dom, qr-scanner, @khmyznikov/pwa-install, @testing-library/*, vite, vitest, @playwright/test) are root devDependencies, resolved via the repo root's node_modules, an ancestor of this directory. The vite/vitest/playwright build and test configs (vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, playwright.config.ts) live here directly (toolchain independence, C4) — no more borrowing from another package's node_modules.
